jewel--noun.def: A valuable stone used in jewellery.

artistic--adj.def: Relating to art, or showing skill in it.
artistic--adj.ex: She comes from an artistic family.

ferry--noun.def: A boat that carries people across water regularly.
ferry--noun.ex: The ferry leaves every half hour.

atomic--adj.def: Relating to atoms or to nuclear energy.
atomic--adj.ex: The country built an atomic plant.

sensation--noun.def: A physical feeling, or great public excitement.

delight--noun.ex: She read the letter with delight.

thorough--adj.def: Done completely and with great care.

sleeve--noun.def: The part of a shirt that covers your arm.

confirmation--noun.def: A statement proving that something is true or booked.

comet--noun.def: An object in space with a bright tail.
comet--noun.ex: A comet passed close last night.
comet--noun.exTr: Dün gece bir kuyruklu yıldız yakından geçti.

cheerful--adj.ex: The nurse had a cheerful voice.

realistic--adj.def: Sensible about what is possible, or true to life.

sufficient--adj.ex: We have sufficient food for a week.

overwhelming--adj.def: So great that you cannot resist or deal with it.

instructor--noun.def: A person who teaches a practical skill.

depressing--adj.def: Making you feel sad and without hope.

backpack--noun.def: A bag carried on your back.

edition--noun.def: One printing of a book or a newspaper.

demonstrate--verb.def: To show clearly how something works or that it is true.

sheer--adj.def: Complete and nothing else, or very steep.

ant--noun.def: A very small insect that lives in large groups.
ant--noun.ex: An ant crawled across the page.

inquiry--noun.def: A question, or an official investigation.
inquiry--noun.ex: They opened an inquiry into the fire.

unemployed--adj.ex: He has been unemployed since spring.

antique--noun.def: An old object that is valuable.
antique--noun.ex: The clock is a real antique.

employment--noun.def: The state of having paid work.

unite--verb.def: To join together into one group.

mule--noun.def: An animal born from a horse and a donkey.

phenomenon--noun.def: Something that exists and can be observed.

ape--noun.def: A large animal like a monkey but without a tail.

annoyed--adj.ex: She was annoyed by the noise.

camel--noun.def: A desert animal with one or two humps.
camel--noun.ex: A camel can go days without water.

sponsor--noun.def: A person or company that pays for an event.
sponsor--noun.ex: The team found a new sponsor.

parrot--noun.def: A colourful bird that can copy speech.

pause--noun.def: A short stop in speaking or acting.

pause--verb.def: To stop for a short time and then continue.

acquaintance--noun.def: A person you know a little but not well.

rail--noun.def: A metal bar, especially one a train runs on.
rail--noun.ex: Hold the rail on the stairs.

crop--noun.def: A plant grown by farmers for food.
crop--noun.ex: Wheat is the main crop here.

careless--adj.def: Not giving enough attention to what you do.

separation--noun.def: The state of being apart from someone.

select--adj.def: Chosen as one of the best.
select--adj.ex: Only a select few were invited.
select--adj.exTr: Sadece seçkin birkaç kişi davet edildi.

visa--noun.def: Official permission to enter a country.

spice--noun.def: A strong-tasting powder or seed used in cooking.

rational--adj.def: Based on reason rather than feeling.
rational--adj.ex: Try to make a rational choice.

competitive--adj.def: Wanting to win, or involving strong competition.

elbow--noun.def: The joint in the middle of your arm.
elbow--noun.ex: He hurt his elbow playing tennis.

mustard--noun.def: A yellow sauce with a hot taste.

transportation--noun.def: The system of carrying people or goods.

immigration--noun.def: The act of coming to live in a new country.

teen--noun.def: A young person between thirteen and nineteen.

aspect--noun.def: One part of a situation or an idea.
aspect--noun.ex: Consider every aspect of the plan.

relate--verb.def: To show a connection, or to tell a story.
relate--verb.ex: The report relates cost to quality.

biology--noun.ex: She teaches biology at the school.

strangely--adv.def: In a way that is unusual or hard to explain.

substitute--noun.def: A person or thing used in place of another.
substitute--noun.ex: A substitute teacher took the class.

aspirin--noun.def: A common medicine for pain and fever.
aspirin--noun.ex: Take an aspirin for the headache.
aspirin--noun.exTr: Baş ağrısı için bir aspirin al.

summit--noun.def: The top of a mountain, or a meeting of leaders.
summit--noun.ex: They reached the summit at noon.

poisonous--adj.def: Containing poison and able to harm you.

disabled--adj.def: Having a condition that limits movement or senses.
disabled--adj.ex: The bus has a disabled ramp.

skeleton--noun.def: All the bones in a body.
skeleton--noun.ex: The museum shows a whale skeleton.

baggage--noun.def: The bags you take on a journey.

undo--verb.def: To open something tied, or to reverse an action.

obtain--verb.def: To get something, especially with effort.

mild--adj.def: Not strong, not severe and not cold.

gorilla--noun.ex: A gorilla sat under the tree.

dynasty--noun.def: A series of rulers from the same family.
